events.title: Rei & The Moving Castle @ UCO Jazz Lab
events.location: UCO Jazz Lab, 100 E 5th St, Edmond, OK 73034
events.description:
Rei & The Moving Castle brings the iconic music of Studio Ghibli and anime to the UCO Jazz Lab stage.
Sat, Nov 14th
Doors @ 7:00 PM | Show @ 8:00 PM
100 E 5th St, Edmond, OK
Led by bassist Rei Wang, the project aims to bring music inspired by the captivating cinematic literary universe known as anime. Growing up in Taiwan during the 1990s, Rei was introduced to the extraordinary work of Studio Ghibli and other anime artists at a young age. This exposure ignited a lifelong appreciation for the genre within her.
Beyond the mesmerizing animation and captivating storytelling, Rei was particularly drawn to the uniquely personal and emotionally resonant music composed by Joe Hisaishi for each story of Studio Ghibli and even the almost tone poem approach of the writers of such favorites as One Piece and Attack on Titan.
Rei’s vision for this project is to simply share the music and emotions that reside within the timeless tales crafted by the magic of Studio Ghibli and the broader universe of the genre that has inspired and influenced her for all of this time. Don’t miss out on Rei & The Moving Castle—there’s room for everyone!
Featuring: Collin Ferrell (sax), Kendrik McKinney (piano), Brian Belanus (guitar), David Bowen (drums), and Rei Wang (bass).
Hideaway Pizza and full bar service are available inside the UCO Jazz Lab during this performance.

events.title: Garrett "Big G" Jacobson (Blues)
events.location: UCO Jazz Lab, 100 E 5th St, Edmond, OK 73034
events.description:
Garrett “Big G” Jacobson brings his acclaimed blues sound, masterful guitar playing, and more than 20 years of live performance experience to the stage.
TICKETS ON SALE SOON
Doors open at 7:00 PM | Show starts at 8:00PM
Tickets will be available for purchase online, at the door, or by calling (405)974-2100
As a dynamic blues performer, Garrett “Big G” Jacobson has been satisfying audiences for more than 20 years. His professional start began at age twelve as a guitarist with Oklahoma bluesman D.C. Minner. Within two years Garrett formed his own band, recorded his first album, and begun performing at numerous clubs and festivals throughout Oklahoma and the surrounding region. Since 1998, he has released five albums and performed continuously. His recordings have received critical praise in national and regional publications such as Living Blues, Blues Revue, Blues Blast, and Southwest Blues. Garrett and his band have performed at notable venues across the country such as the Buddy Guy’s Legends, The Chicago Blues Festival, The Grand Emporium, and B.B. King’s Blues Club. He has also performed with blues greats such as Jimmy Johnson, Carl Weathers by, and Smokey Wilson. With his distinct guitar style and soulful vocals, Garrett Jacobson delivers a soul-satisfying performance not to be forgotten.
Hideaway Pizza and full bar service are available inside the UCO Jazz Lab during all performances.
Event Cost $15
